Book Appointment
Direct answer: You can book an appointment at Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic, Greater Noida, by phone or WhatsApp at +91-96678-63295 or through the online booking form; initial psychiatric consultations take about 45 minutes.

Get Started

Request a confidential mental health consultation

Share only the basic details needed to request an appointment at Mind Grace in Gamma II. Choose your preferred time and continue securely by WhatsApp, email, or phone.

Call Now

Is this the right place to start?

This booking form is appropriate if you:

  • Are seeking help for anxiety, depression, sleep issues, ADHD, or child development concerns
  • Want a confidential psychiatric consultation in Greater Noida
  • Prefer minimal paperwork and a clear intake process
  • Are comfortable sharing basic contact details and preferred appointment time

Not sure if this fits?

Read about our appointment process orcontact us with questions before booking.

Request your appointment

Use the form below to request an appointment. Your appointment is confirmed only after the clinic contacts you with an agreed date and time.

Please confirm this notice before opening the booking form.

Before continuing: The clinic uses this form to coordinate routine appointments. A clinic team member will respond using the contact method you provide.

Share only the basic information needed to request an appointment. Do not use this form for urgent or emergency support.

What happens next?

  1. Submit the form: Takes 2–3 minutes to complete.
  2. Clinic follow-up: The clinic will contact you using your preferred method during operating hours to discuss availability.
  3. Schedule your visit: We'll confirm date, time, and whether you prefer in-person or online consultation.
